scope: Desenho browser isolado; nenhuma alteração de app/runtime, chamada remota ou execução/importação do protótipo.

coordination.planned_module: isolated browser JS module, filename to be agreed
coordination.prototype_rename: signal.py -> acom_signal_codec.py solicitado pelo operador; confirmar arquivo final e hash antes de implementar

memory_projection.shared_transition: Não realizada por esta subtarefa; coordenação por arquivo conforme pedido.

observed_contract.frame: uint32 big-endian header UTF8 byte length + JSON header + payload length from block.wire
observed_contract.acom1: 6-byte ACOM1 NUL magic + uint64le original length + uint32le CRC32 + 32 raw SHA256 bytes + zlib-wrapped deflate
observed_contract.root: SHA256 of Python canonical JSON manifest: scope, sha, bytes, blocks; sorted keys, compact separators, UTF8, no NaN
observed_contract.integrity: CRC32 and SHA256 detect alteration against expected values; neither authenticates peer or encrypts payload.

browser_design.byte_preservation: Codec input/output Uint8Array. Preserve supplied bytes, BOM, CRLF, whitespace and Unicode normalization. Never JSON.parse/stringify payload to calculate its hash. TextEncoder only once at caller boundary if source is a JS string; malformed surrogate policy must be explicit. Decode textual payload only after complete verification, strict UTF8 with BOM preservation policy.
browser_design.hash: crypto.subtle.digest SHA-256 for individual blocks and bounded complete object. WebCrypto has no incremental digest API: do not claim constant-memory object hashing. Reject over limit before concatenation/digest, account for copies and outputs; agree peak-memory budget.
browser_design.compression: Feature detect secure-context crypto.subtle, TextEncoder/TextDecoder, Uint8Array/DataView, readable streams and construct CompressionStream/DecompressionStream with deflate (zlib wrapper, not deflate-raw/gzip). Probe tiny fixed offline vector. No UA-version inference; no arbitrary JS polyfill.
browser_design.encode: Validate full input limits and hash before any POST. Use fixed block slicing from final contract. ACOM1 only if complete compressed frame payload smaller than raw according to reference rule; CRC32 exactly reference. Preconstruct bounded body for portable fetch; no request-stream/duplex dependence.
browser_design.decode: Bound cumulative wire bytes, frame/header count, header length, block wire size and cumulative output before allocations/concatenation. Split fetch chunks locally into bounded parser views; network chunks need not follow prototype Reader chunk boundary. Decompress incrementally with output cap, cancel on cap breach. Validate each header exact fields/types/integers, duplicate keys, sequence, offsets, hashes, final root and EOF. Do not trust Content-Length.
browser_design.strict_json: JSON.parse alone silently accepts duplicate keys; final codec requires duplicate-key detection or reviewed strict parser. Number.isSafeInteger and type checks; bool is not integer. Header nesting must have a small agreed bound.
browser_design.zlib_open: Verify browser decompressor enforces checksum, end-of-stream and no trailing/concatenated streams against Python negatives; if strict parity cannot be established, compressed codec capability remains disabled. Bounded JS reader limits retained output, not an audited bound on internal browser codec allocations.
browser_design.canonicalization: Implement only fixed manifest/context schema needed by frozen contract, ASCII keys with explicit ordered serialization. Check Python-vs-JS UTF8/string escaping and number vectors; do not assume arbitrary JSON canonicalization equivalence.
browser_design.refs: References only from acknowledged exact scope/root and verified byte cache. Partition by authenticated account/generation/conversation, invalidate on logout/account changes, bound cache bytes/count. Wire scope is not authority. No unacknowledged or guessed hashes; no persistence design assumed.
browser_design.visibility: Decoded blocks remain provisional until end hash/root/EOF verification. Commit cache/object and expose complete response page only after success; discard provisional data on failure.

http_integration_proposal_not_wire_contr.negotiation: Authenticated /api/chat-jobs/session may advertise final protocol/capabilities/limits. Exact field names, media type, headers, CSRF and endpoint behavior belong to final server contract; not invented here. Preserve fetchIALD auth/credentials/account-generation checks.
http_integration_proposal_not_wire_contr.unsupported: If capability/API/strict-decoder support absent before submission, use existing JSON protocol. Never infer support from prototype existence; protocol disabled by default pending final review.
http_integration_proposal_not_wire_contr.query_full_delta: Full and delta encode the same original serialized request bytes. Delta requires explicit acknowledged base before sending. A missing base discovered before POST can select full before the first send; no automatic resend after attempt.
http_integration_proposal_not_wire_contr.responses: Each existing cursor page is an independently complete verified payload. Retain event seq, cursor, has_more, terminal status, DONE and withdrawal handling. No delta across response pages unless final contract explicitly adds it; current pages already incrementally deliver events.
http_integration_proposal_not_wire_contr.uncertain_send: Once fetch is invoked for POST, timeout/disconnect/abort/unsupported response/decode failure leaves request pending or uncertain. Do not change protocol, base or request ID and repost. Recovery observes existing identity/job only under server status contract; transport receipt is not provider admission.
http_integration_proposal_not_wire_contr.refusal: Clear local error for excess bounds/corrupt or missing ref. No truncated payload, silent omission, fabricated success or automatic remote repair.

required_final_contract_inputs: Final filename and SHA plus explicit final-contract signal
Exact canonical schema and cross-language vectors
Final object/wire/header/frame/cache and peak-memory limits; 8MiB is provisional
Negotiation fields/media types, authenticated scope binding, capability downgrade rules
Typed no-dispatch vs pending/uncertain responses and status-only recovery
Reference offer/ack lifecycle, account changes, eviction and missing-base behavior
Strict zlib EOF/trailing semantics across browser engines
Policy for invalid UTF8/BOM/lone surrogates and duplicate JSON keys
offline_acceptance_plan: Bidirectional Python-to-JS and JS-to-Python vectors; compare decoded bytes/SHA/root, not compressed byte identity (deflate implementation may differ).
Empty, ASCII, accents, emoji split across blocks, CRLF, BOM, combining forms, all byte values when binary kind, repetitive and incompressible data; exact limit and limit+1.
raw/acom1/ref, full/delta, duplicate blocks, absent/foreign/tampered base and account/generation changes.
1-byte and arbitrary network splits, malformed length/endian/header/duplicate keys/types/order/offsets, truncation, extra frame, CRC/SHA/root mismatch, zlib expansion bomb/trailing streams.
Feature absent and constructor failure before send -> current protocol; simulated lost POST response -> zero reposts or protocol downgrade.
Complete response pages keep cursors/events/DONE/withdrawal semantics; no UI/cache commit before verification.
Measure peak retained JS bytes, total wire bytes including headers and CPU; test actual WebView/browser capabilities offline before claiming support.
science_boundary: Engenharia de transporte byte-lossless proposta. Sem prova física, criptográfica ou ganho cognitivo/compactação garantido. Não altera kernel/gate; relatório científico anterior é referência separada.
